root_cause.text: The `gpio-mvebu` driver fails to verify if a GPIO bank has PWM functionality (by checking if `mvchip->mvpwm` is NULL) before calling `mvebu_pwm_suspend()` and `mvebu_pwm_resume()` during system suspend and resume.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff in `drivers/gpio/gpio-mvebu.c` adds `&& mvchip->mvpwm` to the conditional checks in both `mvebu_gpio_suspend()` and `mvebu_gpio_resume()` to prevent calling the PWM suspend/resume functions when `mvchip->mvpwm` is NULL.
